storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
Video Downloader for TikTok makes it easy to save TikTok videos to your computer as standard MP4 files.

How it works: Browse TikTok normally. Download overlay buttons appear on every video in your feed, on user profile pages, and on single video pages. Click the download button and the video saves as MP4. You can also use the extension popup to download the current video.

The extension uses six different detection strategies to find video URLs — embedded SIGI_STATE data, Universal Data for Rehydration, Next.js data, HTML5 video elements, network request interception, and script tag analysis. It handles TikTok's cookies, authentication tokens, and CDN requirements automatically.

Key features:
- In-feed download overlays on every video while browsing
- Multi-strategy video detection that adapts to TikTok's changing page structure
- Downloads as standard MP4 files — no watermarks from third-party services
- Works on feed pages, user profiles, hashtag pages, music pages, and single video pages
- Automatic TikTok cookie and Referer header handling for reliable CDN access
- Toggle overlays on/off from the popup
- React Fiber extraction for dynamic content
- TikTok API fallback when embedded data is unavailable
- Dark-themed UI with TikTok red and cyan accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to TikTok.com and browse your feed
3. Click the download overlay on any video, or click the extension icon on a video page
4. Video saves as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video?
faq.answer: Browse TikTok normally. Download overlay buttons appear on every video in your feed. Click the download button on any video. You can also visit a single video page and use the extension popup.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from TikTok's bitrateInfo data — typically multiple resolutions. The best available quality is used automatically.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Do downloads have watermarks?
faq.answer: No. Unlike third-party download websites, this extension downloads directly from TikTok's CDN, so there are no added watermarks.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Try scrolling past the video and back, or refreshing the page. TikTok loads video data dynamically, and the extension needs the feed data to load before detection works.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored. The extension only accesses TikTok pages.

faq.question: Can I turn off the download overlays?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the extension popup and toggle 'Show Download Overlays' off. You can still download via the popup.
